drafts.walkScript: Line 5 says "From here she can see the", and the sentence runs on. Line 6 names the "place under the roof where two boards have pulled apart". So she sees a gap where two boards have parted, not the flagstone she stands on. Line 6 also shows "the small traffic going in" and out of that gap. Line 7 says "Her eyes do the counting", so she can count that traffic.
